summary: The promise-diagnostics run failed to compile (exit 101, no events) because the new counters and recording code were inserted into randomized_reconfig_agreement while the safety event that reads them belongs to randomized_reconfig_diagnose_lag. The failure is preserved as a construction failure, not an observation. This revision removes the accidental insertion from the other test and declares and populates the diagnostics inside the run-13 test: up to forty Promises delivered to pid 4 recorded as sender, promise ballot number, accept round of the last accepted entry, accepted index, decided index and whether the log_sync carries a StopSign, plus up to twenty accepted-index transitions on node 4 and its final accepted and decided indices. The seeded 900-action schedule, reconfigure at action 450, 150-round convergence, node 3 trace and the converged_all comparison are unchanged. The receipt will test the max-merge explanation directly: a StopSign-bearing Promise with a lower accept round than a delivered StopSign-free Promise would confirm it, while the absence of such a pattern would favour the late-Promise alternative and require another correction.
